name: LUMEN
description: LUMEN photographs portraits, weddings, brands and landscapes in Taiwan. Natural light, relaxed sessions and honest moments, thoughtfully captured.
heroSubtitle: A quiet lens for honest moments
introTitle: Every photograph holds a moment worth keeping
intro:
Hello, I am the photographer behind LUMEN.
I love natural light and unposed expressions. We can chat during the session so you feel comfortable in front of the camera.
Whether you are marking a milestone, creating images for a brand or documenting this moment in your life, I would love to hear your ideas.

contact.location: Taipei / New Taipei City; available throughout Taiwan
